sloka: निर्भिद्यमानः सहसा सहमानश्च तान् शरान्।कुम्भस्य धनुराक्षिप्य बभञ्जेन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम् ।। ६.७६.७० ।।
transliteration: nirbhidyamānaḥ sahasā sahamānaśca tān śarān।kumbhasya dhanurākṣipya babhañjendradhanuṣprabham ।। 6.76.70 ।।

translations.english: He snatched the bow of Kumbha forcibly which was like Indra's rainbow, pulled it and broke, while tolerating the pain of the arrows.
